title: Ancient but Digitized: Developing Handwritten Optical Character Recognition for East Syriac Script Through Creating KHAMIS Dataset
reasoning: The paper is a technical report on creating a dataset (KHAMIS) and fine-tuning an OCR model for the East Syriac script. While the script is historically associated with Christian communities and the dataset is derived from poems by a priest, the research focuses on character recognition performance metrics and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
